studies.study_title: Reactions and platelet increments after transfusion of platelet concentrates in plasma or an additive solution: a prospective, randomized study
studies.predicted_reason: Prospective randomized study evaluating prophylactic platelet transfusions in 21 patients treated with intensive chemotherapy for hematologic malignancies. Patients were randomly assigned to receive prophylactic transfusions of PCs prepared in either plasma or PAS-2. Measures clinical responses including corrected count increments (CCIs). Fits selection criteria as it involves prophylactic platelet transfusions in patients with haematological disorders undergoing chemotherapy.

studies.study_title: Efficacy of prophylactic transfusions using single donor apheresis platelets versus pooled platelet concentrates in AML/MDS patients receiving allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation
studies.predicted_reason: RCT comparing prophylactic single-donor apheresis platelets (SDAP) versus pooled platelet concentrates (PPC) in 33 patients with AML/MDS during the first 100 days after allogeneic HSCT. Transfusion threshold was platelet count ≤15 x 10^9/L for prophylactic purposes. Reports hemorrhage episodes (6%) and concludes both products were equally effective in preventing hemorrhage. Directly addresses the review question of prophylactic platelet transfusion for bleeding prevention in haematological disorders after stem cell transplantation.
